svg.text: FTIR-LDIR-Raman pipeline: from instrument exports to matched particles and agreement
Raman is the reference frame: every other instrument is aligned onto it. Each run writes everything into one output folder.
Common particle table: particle_id, x_um, y_um, feret/major/minor, area, material, quality
Input contract: µm coordinates required · no empty file · unique IDs · decimal comma accepted · annotate_materials() adds material_polymer + material_family
Image placement — display only, never changes results
FTIR: image particles registered to the table (→ ftir_image_placement.json)
Raman: WITec width/height/centre, or auto-calibration against the particles
LDIR: the same scan circle as the coordinates (→ manifest)
Used by the viewer and the report to draw each image under its particles
All particles with valid coordinates go to alignment; matching set may use size/quality prefilters (default: none)
Each cloud is centred on its own full-cloud centroid (x_norm = x_um − mean): a common origin only, the aligners find the real offset
Run separately for FTIR→Raman, Bruker→Raman and LDIR→Raman. Tier 1 skips Tier 2 when confident. Seeded (align_seed): identical inputs give identical transforms.
Output: x_aligned, y_aligned in the Raman frame (Raman µm minus Raman centroid) + 3×3 similarity transform (scale, rotation, mirror, shift).
gate 100 µm (LDIR pairs 250 µm), widened for large
per pair: distance, ambiguity score; 1:many composites
display only (does not affect alignment, matching or agreement)
Entry points: main.R (pipeline), shiny_app/app.R (viewer). Parameters: make_config() in R/00_config.R.
Key modules: R/01_ingest.R, R/01c_ingest_ldir.R, R/03b_landmark_align.R, R/04_ransac.R, R/06_icp_refine.R, R/07_match.R,
